utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on the confirmed repair drive update, but I should have it soon and I’ll share it with you before Saturday. If you want, I can also check in with the main block captains first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — I’d appreciate that. I’m happy to wait for the update, and checking with the block captains first sounds like a good idea.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check in with the Maple and Pine block captains first and keep you posted as soon as I have the confirmed repair drive update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I’m still trying to pin down what we need most for the repair drive. If you’ve got the details handy, I’d appreciate the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I remember it’s mostly tools, spare parts, and small appliances that still have some life in them. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll keep that in mind and see if we can round up a few more of those items.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still checking the school pickup timing, but 3:30 to 5:30 still looks like the best window for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — that window sounds good. Let me know if the timing changes, and I’ll keep an ear out too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep it quiet and help where needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Appreciate it, Uli — that works perfectly. I’ll keep it low-key and fill you in when it’s time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, Dane. Just let me know when you need me, and I’ll be there quietly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — I’ll meet you at the community center front steps at 3:30, and I’ll bring my list so we can sort the route and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that’s still the plan for the repair drive before Saturday? I just want to make sure the details are locked in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes — that’s still the plan: community center front steps at 3:30 on Saturday, and I’ll bring my list for the route and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Bo — send me the list of tools you still need, and I’ll see what I can lend for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll grab the list and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Bo — I’ll keep an eye out and set aside whatever tools I can for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still waiting on the repair details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word and line up a few more neighbors. Send the details my way when they’re ready, and I’ll help get everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send the details as soon as they come in, and I appreciate you helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — 3:30 to 5:30 still looks like the best window for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ve got 3:30 to 5:30 noted. Where should we meet at the community center, and who’s the first repair I should log?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s meet by the front entrance at the community center, and start with the first repair that comes in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — just let me know the timing and where drop-off should be, and I can take a few if they’re clearly labeled.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and drop-off can happen there during the event. If you can label the items, that’ll make sorting much easier.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that works for me — Sunday at the community center sounds easy enough, and I can take a few labeled repairs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep reminding folks and make sure the repair-drive details get around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. I’ll try to keep up and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — just bring what you can, and I’ll keep everyone posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — are donations still coming in, or are we ready to start?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still checking, Mina — once I confirm what’s on hand and what’s missing, I’ll let everyone know if we’re ready to start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo — just let me know what’s still missing and whether we can start yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ll note that the repair drive is still in the gathering phase, with just a few odds and ends left. Let me know if anything major comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll keep asking around and let you know if anything major changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep tracking it, and please send any updates if the repair drive list changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep reminding folks about the repair drive and make sure everyone knows what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik — can you also share the repair drive time and what people should bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive time and what folks should bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still piecing it together, Noah — have the donations started coming in, or are we still gathering things for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Oren — I’m still waiting on the update, so I don’t want to guess yet. I’ll bring what I can once I know the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — I’ll check in and get the repair-drive details sorted, then I’ll let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll sort the donated items by category and set them aside for pickup. If I notice anything missing, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — that should help a lot. Let me know if anything’s missing or needs a quick follow-up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the repair drive details, so I don’t want to guess yet. Once I confirm what’s left, I’ll share the status and donation progress.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Hana — just let me know once you’ve confirmed the repair drive status and donation progress, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’m checking the details now, and I’ll let you know the repair drive status and donation progress as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up too—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still putting the list together, Nell, but I’ll send the repair details as soon as I have them and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good, Rey — I’m still catching up, so send the details whenever you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — once Cleo’s done checking supplies, I’ll help fill in whatever’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — once Cleo checks the supplies, tell me what’s missing and I’ll log it. We’re still set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — I’ll let you know as soon as Cleo has the list, and we can keep it quiet and on track for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now, Eli, and I’ll let you know what we’re short on. Once I’ve got the list, I can point you to the first repair job.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo. Once you’ve got the list, I’ll confirm the route and we’ll sort out who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll send you the short supply list as soon as I finish checking, and then we can lock in the route.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — we’re collecting basics like tape, screws, glue, and a few small tools. I’ll send you the full list and drop-off details right after this.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — send the list and drop-off details when you can, and I’ll round up what I have.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — send it when you can, and I’ll take a quiet look. Just let me know where I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I’ll send the updated sheet soon and let you know exactly where you’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll keep my part quiet and look it over when it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Pia — has the repair drive started yet, or are donations still coming in?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Donations can still come in, but I’d want the repair list to stay small and clearly labeled. If that works, drop-off at my place is easiest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — is the repair drive officially started yet, and what donations do you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s right — it’s still in the gathering stage, just a few odds and ends left to collect. I’ll keep asking around and let you know if anything major changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay — can you confirm you’ll tell me as soon as you have the final details before Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll tell you as soon as I’ve got the final details, definitely before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’m still checking the school pickup timing, but 3:30 to 5:30 still looks like the best window for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That window sounds good to me — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything else about the repair drive.
